content:
Some meetings leave you with a photograph. Others leave you with ideas, perspectives, and renewed motivation!

Recently, I had the pleasure of meeting and interacting with the Executive Members of the Delhi High Court Bar Association - Mr. Nitesh Mehra, Advocate, Mr. Amit Choudhary and Ms. Kanika Singh (Treasurer). I was also pleased to present my book, “Handbook on Arrest and Rights of the Accused.”

The interaction, however, went well beyond the book. We had meaningful discussions on the evolving legal profession, the importance of safeguarding the rights of the accused, and contemporary issues in the field of criminal law. 

It was genuinely encouraging to interact with such dynamic and insightful office bearers who continue to engage with the concerns of members of the Bar and motivate the younger generation of advocates. For a young advocate, interactions like these are more than just meetings, they are opportunities to listen, learn and understand the profession beyond the courtroom.

Moments like these are reminders that the Bar is a community where experience meets new perspectives, ideas are exchanged freely, and one comes away with something to think about. It was a pleasure meeting Nitesh Mehra, Advocate Sir, Mr. Amit Chauhan and Ms. Kanika Singh, and I look forward to continuing such meaningful interactions with the Bar. 

The most meaningful conversations do not end when the meeting does—they continue to shape the way we think, engage and practise!

Delhi High Court Bar Association Law Offices of Advocate Akash Sharma
